text: 7月9日，福建省泉州市晋江市陈埭镇一鞋厂发生重大火灾，造成28人死亡。国务院安委会决定对该起重大火灾查处挂牌督办，并派出国家消防救援局牵头的现场督办组，督促指导福建省开展调查处理工作，要求福建省依照有关法律法规及规章规定，抓紧组织开展调查，尽快查明起火原因和管理原因，精准确定火灾性质，查清责任，严肃提出处理意见和整改措施。（央视新闻）
text_en: On July 9, a major fire broke out at a shoe factory in Chendai Town, Jinjiang City, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province, resulting in 28 deaths. The State Council Work Safety Committee decided to supervise and handle this major fire case, and dispatched an on-site supervision team led by the National Fire and Rescue Administration, urging Fujian Province to carry out investigation and handling. The committee requires Fujian Province to organize an investigation in accordance with relevant laws and regulations, promptly determine the cause of the fire and management reasons, accurately identify the nature of the fire, clarify responsibilities, and seriously propose handling opinions and corrective measures. (CCTV News)
